description: A production designer must approve the final scenic build package for a filmed musical number, including the platform configuration, scenic fabric, and camera access plan before construction begins.

shared_context.S1: The production is preparing a large scenic platform and fabric backdrop for a filmed musical number on Stage 4.
shared_context.S2: Mara must approve the build package before the scenic crew begins construction.
shared_context.S3: The current draft package calls for one 700 kg scenic platform, a red fabric backdrop, and a west-side camera entrance.
shared_context.S4: At the daily build meeting, Mara records each department's signoff and any required changes before issuing the final build package.

PF1.text: Elliot received the stage engineer's revised floor-load map after the draft package circulated: the planned 700 kg platform cannot be concentrated on one area, and the approved alternative is three separate platforms with load spreaders, each carrying no more than 400 kg. He has not uploaded the revised map to the build packet yet.

PF2.text: Nia confirmed with the fabric supplier this morning that the only available backdrop material with the required flame-retardant certification is 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7; the draft red fabric has no current certification. She is still waiting on the purchase order before entering the confirmation in the materials log.

PF3.text: Jonas's camera test after blocking showed that the crane needs a clear west-to-east lane 2.4 meters wide, so the scenic entrance must be on the east side rather than the draft west-side entrance. The test note remains in his camera report and has not been added to the scenic drawings.

acceptance_conditions: The platform must be divided into three platforms with a 400 kg load limit and load spreaders.
The backdrop must use exactly 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7 fabric.
The scenic package must provide a 2.4 meter camera lane.
The scenic entrance must be on the east side.
The revised structural, materials, and camera findings must be cited by the decision-maker after being revealed by their owners.

content_checks.C2: decisions['platform_load_limit_kg'] == 400 and decisions['floor_protection'] in ['load spreaders', 'load spreaders under each platform']

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and all(f in revealed for f in justification_fact_ids)

decisive_facts.why: The revised floor-load map changes the platform count from one 700 kg platform to exactly three platforms with a 400 kg limit and load spreaders.
The supplier confirmation changes the backdrop from red fabric to exactly 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7 and requires the decision-maker to cite that materials finding.
The camera test changes the required lane to exactly 2.4 meters and moves the scenic entrance from the west side to the east side.
